# Feature Map Entry (per-capability)

One file per capability: .mochiko/features/FEAT-XXX-<slug>.md. Authored and amended per
mochiko:authoring-feature-map — the skill carries the derivation method, the work-row and
fold rules, and the write timing; this shape carries only the structure. An entry is a
durable capability plus a block of transient work rows (its delivery increments); there is
NO parent/leaf nesting — capabilities are flat, grouped by domains only at the soft cap
(mochiko:patterns-map-minimalism). Status is owned HERE (and mirrored one-line in
FEATURES.md): story files derive theirs by following the FEAT-ID. Omit empty sections per
artifact-format.md rule 6.

## Header & Status

Title "# FEAT-{{XXX}} — {{capability_name}}" plus a Status line
(proposed | in-flight | delivered | retired) and one status-dependent detail line:
  in-flight  -> since {{date}} · live work rows in run(s): `.mochiko/specs/{{spec-slug}}/`
                (or the owning lane run, for feature-command growth-door work)
  delivered  -> since {{date}} · sticky — live rows may still be visible below
  retired    -> {{date}} · ruling: {{pointer}}  (or, on a merge: merged-into FEAT-{{YYY}})
  proposed   -> surfaced by {{spec-slug}} ({{date}}) — or, for a capability stub,
                minted by /mochiko:feature ({{date}}) · marked `unrefined`
Reconstructed entries add: `reconstructed-from-code ({{date}}) — first touching spec
re-verifies extent` — cleared at that spec's acceptance. `unrefined` stubs carry name +
one-breath hook only — no Extent, no work rows; only specify's derivation fills them and
makes the entry selectable.

## Capability

1-3 lines, the system's own language — what the product does, standing on its own without
reference to any story or spec. More than ~3 lines of extent below usually means this is
two capabilities, or its bulk is undelivered work rows.

_Density:_ 1-3 lines

## Extent

What is in, and what is notably NOT in — one line each. This is where stories sharpen the
capability over time, and where a delivered work row folds in at its landing. (Absent on
an `unrefined` stub.)

_Density:_ one line each

## Work rows — optional

Transient delivery increments under this capability — one line each, newest first. Each
row carries a state and its run pointer; a `live` row folds into Extent above at its
acceptance landing and leaves this list, a `pending` row persists as open obligation
(deferred work never silently disappears). Grammar:
  - `pending` — {{increment}} · acceptance: {{criteria}} · cut by {{spec-slug or lane-run}}
  - `live`    — {{increment}} · acceptance: {{criteria}} · in {{spec-slug or lane-run}}
Story-shaped increments are fine here; a story-shaped *capability* is not.

_Density:_ one line each, newest first

## Relations — optional

One line per relation to another FEAT-ID: depends-on / extends / composes-with. A work row
may depend on another capability's row — note it here; row-level dependencies order the
two capability-batch runs.

_Density:_ one line per relation

## Architecture — optional

Which architecture-store elements realize this capability, named by id: SPN-XXX spine
elements — any kind (container | boundary | flow) — and/or AX-XXX concern rows, at
.mochiko/product/architecture/. Pointers only, navigable both directions; never restate
the element. (Domain -> element mapping is dormant: it lands only at the soft cap, per
mochiko:patterns-map-minimalism.)

## Story trace — optional

Accumulating provenance: which specs/stories informed this capability — IDs and pointers
only, newest first.

_Density:_ IDs and pointers only, newest first

## Obligations — optional

Deferred completeness pointers riding this entry until the work builds — one line each,
distinct from work rows (which are cut delivery increments): deferred SC-XXX (travels here
when its covering capability went unselected) · deferred seams ("when built, verify seam
against FEAT-XXX") · cross-cutting extend obligations from stories homed elsewhere.

_Density:_ one line each

## Skeleton

# FEAT-{{XXX}} — {{capability_name}}

> Status: {{status}}  <!-- proposed | in-flight | delivered | retired -->
> {{status_line_detail}}

## Capability

{{capability_statement}}

## Extent

- {{in_scope_line}}
- Not: {{out_of_scope_line}}

## Work rows

- `live` — {{increment}} · acceptance: {{criteria}} · in {{spec_or_lane_run}}

## Relations

- depends-on: {{FEAT-ID}} — {{one_line_why}}

## Architecture

- {{SPN-XXX | AX-XXX}} — {{element_name}} (`.mochiko/product/architecture/`)

## Story trace

- {{spec-slug}}: US-{{n}}, US-{{n}}

## Obligations

- {{obligation_line}}
